title: RAW UNREVIEWED: qoqokeey as reciprocal transfer of the same material under an explicit whole-clause head
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. In complete already-owned f75v.39, derive qoqokeey from opaque qokeey=TRANSFER by one outer qo=RECIPROCALIZE, requiring both ordered endpoint roles for the same portion within the full chosen operation. Preserve all f75v.38–42 and43–49 groups, exact free qokeey including doublets, unknown arguments, and all prior C0 debts. The changed NOT_ONCE obligation is a consequence of the proposed positive head, not an observed meaning result.

design.complete_C0_positive_reading: Carry out reciprocal transfer of a mixture, a portion of liquid: pour that liquid from B to A, then from A to B, [once / repeatedly].
design.base: qokeey is one identical R(P,source,destination,event)=TRANSFER relation inside qoqokeey and at every exact free occurrence in the two named units. It remains morphologically opaque.
design.derived_whole: qo|qokeey: RECIP(R)(P,A,B,E) requires distinct events e1/e2 in the same chosen E with R(P,B,A,e1) and R(P,A,B,e2). Outer qo alone does not impose temporal order.
design.exact_scope: The head is asserted/prescriptive, over groups5–11 of f75v.39, with groups2–4 introducing P and group12 scoping over the entire E. No automatic scope across .40–42 or across paragraphs. Only this bound outer-qo application is licensed; no bare-qo or global qoqo rule.
written_participant_bindings: olkain [qol sheedy] introduces one portion P characterized as mixture/liquid; juxtaposed apposition and PORTION binder are paid rules.
Second sheedy at group6 is stipulated anaphoric to P; repeated material class is not independently shared material identity. RF remains open.
qokeor=POUR is stipulated to realize the identical TRANSFER relation, not a new unrelated predicate.
qokal or supplies goal A/source B; qokar ol supplies goal B/source A with shared A/B and A≠B. The locations are hypothetical, not pictured basin identities.
chey=THEN orders the two events and licenses an omitted second POUR and P. NOT is retained as the competing old operator value.
aiin=ONCE or REPEAT applies to the complete two-leg operation; no tail choice is selected.
